text: At 65 minutes, Seabrook Town adjusts their tactics by pressing higher and increasing directness in their play, moving their defensive line further up the field. This change affects the whole pitch, with Seabrook Town aiming to disrupt Harbour City’s patient short passing style. The score remains Harbour City 2, Seabrook Town 1[#1361].

They increase their pressing intensity and play more directly, aiming to disrupt Harbour City’s patient build-up. Despite this, Harbour City maintains control in the centre and right side near the halfway line, managing Seabrook’s pressure into wider areas without giving away clear chances [#1361].
